thread:
alex: Heads-up — planning to onboard ivory-7b-compact into model-catalog tomorrow 2026-03-19 09:30 PT. Need deploy owner, smoke checks, and rollback plan. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/4122 @maria @chen

maria: I can own the deploy up to 10:30 PT (then OOO). Can we keep a 30m canary window? :ok_hand:

chen: I\'ll run the smoke suite and perf checks. Test plan is here: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/ivory-7b-smoke.md — note quant profile: q4_0 should be used for reduced mem.

deploy-scheduler: slot reserved on dedicated-pool-3 for 09:20-10:40 PT by @maria (ticket RED-7891)

devops: infra checklist — make sure model artifacts in s3://model-registry/ivory/7b-compact/ are signed, image built with cuda14 kernels, and LB health checks configured.

dina: Quick question: do we pin under alias ivory-7b:stable or create a new version alias? Also need explicit rollback instructions (alias swap + drain).

alex: Plan: pin as ivory-7b:compact-v1, canary at 5% traffic for first 15m, then 25% for next 15m if metrics look good. Rollback = alias swap to ivory-6b-legacy + abort ongoing batch jobs. Pin PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/4123

maria: Metrics to watch: p95 latency, 99th, error rate, GPU mem spikes, and token throughput. I\'ll monitor SLO dashboard and traces. Alert thresholds: p95 > 450ms or error rate > 0.5% -> rollback.

chen: Smoke commands (run after deploy):
```
# sanity generate
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' -d '{"model":"ivory-7b:compact-v1","prompt":"Summarize: Redwood Inference mission"}'
```
and embedding check:
```
python tests/embeddings_check.py --model ivory-7b:compact-v1
```

sree: Confirming capacity — we have 12 GPUs in dedicated-pool-3, should be OK for 10 concurrent instances, tagging cost center ENG-ML.

alex: Reserved capacity confirmed (RED-7891). Merge timing: @maria will merge PR at T-5 unless any last-minor issues.

dina: I\'ll prepare rollback playbook in runbook/rollbacks/ivory-7b-compact.md and post when done.

maria: Merging at 09:25 PT, will post updates in this thread. If anyone needs to be paged, ping @oncall.

alex: Awesome, thanks all :thumbsup:
